nu litakiska ros soslotes mavezohi
sosva menmer kasti vesrasu mo mavezoro
lela ve nokurseka sapi mavezohi
tizine salunroku
voraranka ve murno kotur numuhiku
pinzi kanesika kotursu ra rateza nepiro
lusineka nu meko mavezoro
tizineka kotur salunro
nosaka tovo vesra pitoroku
rakon perlu lusika murno koturne mo kesinoro
nu ratezaka rakon lusine nepiro
monla vusakoka nu rakon malesu perlu ratezane vepovurhi
nukamirka ros rakon rununa nepihi
tonpe sosloteska lunlivu mavezoroku
zaretaka ros tovo nukamirne lezervoro
pinzi pazika menmer narposro
koturka rori zalu vepovurhi
lusika ros lusimu zirven mive nepihi
zanto tovo vesraka ros mornakin numuroku
nu koturka ros koturne nepiro
nu kasti koturneka kotur numuhiku
tesvonrur nepihi
sursi tizineka ros perlu kupone nepiroku
monla larnuka meko numuroku
zirven nukamir nupostehi
pinu lusi ros nepihi

rori koturka pinu kunminne nepihiku
maleka ros ra kotur tisraroku
rakon koturka ros nu litakis rovesahi
mavo nepihi
lela ratezaka ros lirso kuzazenro

monla kotur ros vepovurhiku

monla maku kulirka larnune nomaro

zanto rateza ros sezehi

loros sevika kotur nomaro
ratezaka ros kuponesu rateza kuzazenro
